Communication is not directly related with intelligence. Just because something can communicate, doesn't mean it's intelligent, and just because something can't speak, doesn't mean it isn't intelligent.

It's the "China Room" problem. Imagine a guy in a locked room. Every once in a while, through a slit in the door, a piece of paper with a bunch of squiggles on it comes in. The guy looks it over, but he has no idea what it means. However, inside the room, there are a bunch of books that tell him how to respond to each squiggle. So he responds to these squiggles, with the proper grammar and syntax and all that jazz, without ever understanding what they mean.

This is the biggest problem with the Turing test. You don't need to know a language in order to speak it or respond to it.

The Gamergate wiki is pretty accurate but here is a tl;dr version.

Gaming journalists hate their audience, they don't enjoy games, they enjoy identity politics and try to use their platform to push their agenda. Gamers got sick of it and started to ignore the press mostly and just accept they were going to post articles full of misandry and racism. Then an indie game developer (she made an interactive story)'s ex posted a run down on how she domestically abused him and slept with multiple games journalists who pushed her "game" on their websites. This got out and people started to talk about it under the name "Quinnspiracy", the deeper people dug, the more the corruption was obvious. Gamers had finally had enough and started a full on revolt against the media. Then a mass wave of censorship happened, 4chan, Reddit and every major gaming news website refused to cover the story, they banned discussion, banned people for even attempt to discuss it and that caused it to spread like wild fire. Everyone wanted to know why some no name developer was so important that no one was allowed to discuss how her sleeping with journalists and causing a conflict of interest. It turned out they were trying to censor it because she was a woman and in their identity politic's world view if you oppose 1 nasty woman you oppose all women, so they had no choice but to rally round this woman, even though she is the text book definition of an abusive, cheating, vile little bitch.

Adam Baldwin (a hollywood actor) came across the videos and joked it should be called Gamergate, which it then became known as. In response the journalists decided to post articles claiming "Gamers are dead" and "Gamers don't need to be your audience", the response was for Gamergate to look harder at these news sources and found a barrel full of corruption and suspicious behavior from dodgy awards, to covering housemates/girlfriend's games without stating they had a personal relationship and sexual favours out the ass. (This is now covered by Deep freeze, a website set up to cover unethical journalist behavior).

From this point forward, it became a battle of the culture war. Feminist ideology known as "progressiveness" and "cultural Marxism" on one side and Gamers on the other. The feminists press arguing that gamers hate women and are driving them out of the industry, while a diverse group of gamers argued that the press needs to go fuck themselves because they're corrupt and pushing feminist propaganda into a space where it isn't welcome. From there to here not a lot has changed. Gamergate has been contacting advertisers of various corrupt media outlets and cost them millions of dollars, multiple journalists have lost their jobs or "relocated" else where and basically Gamergate has pushed identity politics out of gaming and made it "undesirable" to be part of.

The key to remember when seeing articles about Gamergate is the conflict is entirely about unethical journalism and identity politics (read : feminism) being injected into a space where it's not welcome and only causes trouble. The unethical press has zero defense against this, there is no way to say "yea, we had a secret mailing list to push our agenda across every major gaming website, but we're not unethical". So instead of defending themselves, they took to the offensive in the only way identity politics zealots know how to, using -isms. You're racist/sexist/transphobic/right wing conservative traditionalist/whatever because you don't support progressive identity politics. So any coverage you will see will focus entirely on 3 people, 2 of which self inserted themselves (Wu and Anita) and 1 who isn't important but is the straw who broke the camel's back. They all have connections to a PR company at the center of the corruption (silverstring media), who once again are part of the feminist progressive's identity politics group, which gamers are tired of being abused by and want out of positions of power in their community.
